description: Tool to retrieve a list of Stripe Checkout Sessions with pagination support. Use when you need to list checkout sessions, optionally filtering by customer, status, payment intent, or other criteria.

created.description: Filter by creation date range using gt (greater than), gte (greater than or equal), lt (less than), lte (less than or equal) for timestamp bounds.
created.title: Created

customer.title: Customer

payment_link.description: Filter by Payment Link ID that created the session.

starting_after.description: Pagination cursor for retrieving the next page of results.
starting_after.title: Starting After
